soul_lamp.title: Soul Lamp
soul_lamp.description: While you have Soul Lamp, [purple]Bound[/purple] cards can be played for free and [red]ignore restrictions[/red]. Playing a [purple]Bound[/purple] card consumes [blue]1[/blue].
binding_oath.title: Binding Oath
binding_oath.description: You may only play [blue]1[/blue] [purple]Bound[/purple] card each turn. [purple]Bound[/purple] is no longer removed at end of turn.
QUEEN_SUMMON_DYNAMIC.description:
Summon the [gold]Amalgam[/gold] with [blue]{Summon}[/blue] HP.
If already summoned, increase its Max HP by [blue]{Summon}[/blue] for this combat.
QUEEN_SUMMON_DYNAMIC.title: Summon {Summon}
QUEEN_SUMMON_STATIC.description:
Summon the [gold]Amalgam[/gold].
If already summoned, increase its Max HP for this combat.
QUEEN_SUMMON_STATIC.title: Summon
learn_intent.description:
Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] lights [blue]1[/blue] torch, records the corresponding intent, and switches its current intent to that torch's intent.
If all [blue]3[/blue] torches are lit, instead immediately execute that intent action.
learn_intent.title: Learn
forget_intent.description: If the Amalgam's current intent is one recorded on a torch, that torch is cleared and the current intent switches to the next recorded intent.
forget_intent.title: Forget
capture.title: Capture
capture.description: If the target is not a [gold]Minion[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] extra [gold]card[/gold] reward at end of combat. Drag this card to preview the capture reward.
fabricate_defensive_derived_cards.title: Defensive
fabricate_defensive_derived_cards.descri:
[gold]Guard[/gold]: Learn Intent: Gain 10 Block.
[gold]Noise[/gold]: Learn Intent: Draw 1 card. Next turn, draw 1 card. Enchant both cards with: [purple]Dazed[/purple].
fabricate_offensive_derived_cards.title: Offensive
fabricate_offensive_derived_cards.descri:
[gold]Stab[/gold]: Learn Intent: Deal 11 damage. The target loses 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
[gold]Zap[/gold]: Learn Intent: Deal 14 damage.
